gift: A little moment. Yours to keep.
waiting: Your photos are on their way.
waiting_body: I'm selecting and editing your photographs. Keep this card and come back to this link in a few days.
email_hint: Only so the photographer can reach you about these photos. It is never used to send automatic messages.
free: These photos are yours to download. You don't need to give permission to publish.
decision_body: You decide whether I may publish and use the {n} photos on this page, in any form: online, on social media, in print, and commercially. Your answer covers all of them. The full text below says exactly what you agree to. You can change your mind here anytime.
decision_body_one: You decide whether I may publish and use the photo on this page, in any form: online, on social media, in print, and commercially. The full text below says exactly what you agree to. You can change your mind here anytime.
new_photos_notice: New photos were added since your decision. Your answer now covers all of them.
accounts: Where you can find my work
allow: Allow me to publish all photos
name: Your full name
anonymous: Do not name or tag me
adult: I am the person pictured and I am 18 or older.
minor: For anyone under 18, please contact the photographer.
release: Read what you are agreeing to
deleted_body: The photographer has deleted the photos on this card, so this gallery is closed. Your decision record stays available here.
unavailable_body: Unfortunately there isn't a finished photograph for this card. Thank you for sharing a moment with me.
not_found: We couldn't open that photo card.
allowed: Permission to publish given for all photos
g_intro: One walk, from a printed card to a permission you can rely on. Most steps happen away from the app.
f_intro: Short answers about cards, uploads, permissions and what the person on the other side sees.
c_deleted_none: The photos on this card were deleted
c_deleted_none_sub: Their files are gone; the decision history and the activity log remain.
c_delete_body: For when the person asks you to delete their photos. The files on this card are erased for good, the person's link says the photos were deleted, and the decision records stay. Remove your own copies from your library and posts yourself.
c_delete_confirm: Permanently delete the photos on this card? This cannot be undone.
err_nothing_to_delete: This card has no assigned photos to delete.
how_download_body: They are yours. No permission needed to keep them.
how_choose_body: May I publish and use them, online, in print or commercially? One answer covers all your photos, and you can change it here anytime.
photos_hint: Download any photo in full resolution, free.
allow_one: Allow me to publish the photo
replace_notice: Saving replaces your previous decision for all photos.
opened_intro: These cards were opened by their recipient before any photo was grouped or attached. These people are waiting on you.
batch_downloaded: Final PDF downloaded {date}. It cannot be downloaded again.
batch_once_note: The final PDF downloads once. Print it, then delete the file, so no code is ever handed out twice.
batch_local_note: Final printing needs a lasting public URL; only the preview is available here.
err_batch_downloaded: This batch has already been downloaded. Generate a new batch instead of reprinting.
unused_empty: Every generated code has been detected, opened, or used to assign photos.
opened_empty: No one is waiting on you right now.
cards_intro: Generate named batches, print the sheet once, and hand cards out. A card joins a photo set automatically when its photographed QR marker is detected.
one_card: Generate a single QR card on the street
cards_empty_hint: Generate a batch or a one-off card.
batch_note: The batch name is informational. Photographing a card's QR marker associates it with photos later.
unused_one: 1 generated code has never been detected, opened, or used to assign photos.
unused_many: {n} generated codes have never been detected, opened, or used to assign photos.
purge_confirm: Permanently purge every unused QR code? This cannot be undone.
purge_note: The card records are removed completely, so the same code may be generated again in the future.
b_footer: A photograph is a gift. Permission is a choice.
d_place: A place for your next walk
p_lead: Use this when you need a single QR code instead of a printed batch. It will join a set when its marker appears in an upload.
p_notice: The local demo QR opens only on this computer. Configure a public address before handing cards to recipients.
pr_intro: Tell people who photographed them and where they can find your work.
pr_accounts: Where people can find your work
pr_accounts_hint: Fill in only what you use; empty ones are not shown. A username, @username or a pasted profile link all work. Shown as links beside the permission question and kept in each decision record; earlier records keep what they were shown.
pr_release_notice: The default text is a starting point, not legal advice: adapt it before handing out cards. Editing creates a new immutable version. Previous decisions keep their original text and scope. Broader uses need a new permission request.
s_no_marker: No People in Photographs QR marker was found. The photographs were uploaded, but none were assigned to a card.
s_cleaned_one: Deleted 1 unassigned photo from this set.
s_cleaned_many: Deleted {n} unassigned photos from this set.
s_js_drop: Drop the JPEGs to start uploading.
s_upload_intro: Choose how the QR marker appears in your camera sequence.
s_after_hint: Use when someone asks for their photos afterward. The QR closes that group.
s_before_hint: Use for planned portraits. The QR starts that person's group.
s_or_drop: or drop JPEGs anywhere in this panel
s_order: Files are read in filename order. QR marker frames are not added to a recipient gallery.
err_attach_delivered: This photo was assigned to a QR card and cannot be moved.
s_empty_group: Marker found; no photographs were inside this group.
s_close_confirm: Close this QR group without assigning any photos?
s_select_hint: Select only the photos that belong to this QR card. Unchecked photos stay private and unassigned.
s_no_groups_sub: Upload a camera sequence containing one of your QR cards.
s_cleanup_title: Remove photos that are not assigned to a QR card
s_unassigned_one: 1 photo is not assigned to any QR card. This permanently removes their stored files.
s_unassigned_many: {n} photos are not assigned to any QR card. This permanently removes their stored files.
s_cleanup_hint: Available after every detected QR group has an assigned photo or is marked “Do not assign photos.”
s_delete_confirm: Permanently delete every unassigned photo in this set?
s_ask_consent: Ask recipients for permission to publish
s_ask_consent_hint: Their card page asks once whether you may publish and use all their photos. Your permission text on the Profile page sets the exact terms. Leave it off where you don't need consent.
pv_not_asked: Permission not asked for this set
pv_not_covered: Added after the decision: awaiting a new one
pv_unassigned: Not assigned to a QR card
pv_unassigned_hint: Nobody can open this photo and no decision can be made until it is attached to a card.
pv_attach_title: Which QR card does this person hold?
pv_attach_hint: The photo joins that card's proposed group, private until you assign it. A photo proposed to the wrong card moves.
s_attached: Added to the card's group. Review the group below and assign it.
ev_photo_attached_by_hand: {filename} added to the card's group by hand
pv_marker_title: Is this a QR card the scanner missed?
pv_marker_hint: If this frame shows one of your QR cards, enter the code printed on it. The photo becomes that card's marker and the upload it came with is grouped again.
pv_marker_button: Use as QR marker and regroup
c_qr_alt: QR code for this photo card
c_deliver_this: Assign this photograph to this QR card
c_none_sub: The card will join a set automatically when this QR appears in an uploaded camera sequence.
c_select_hint: Select only the photographs that belong to this person. Unchecked candidates will remain private and unassigned.
c_processing: The photographs are processing. This page will refresh when the group is ready.
c_no_decision: No decision yet. Downloading does not count as permission.
a_intro: Decisions, assignment updates and background jobs.
a_quiet_sub: When someone opens a card or makes a decision, it will appear here.
ev_consent_change: {name} changed the decision: all {total} photos allowed
ev_photos_grouped_from_qr: {count} photos grouped from the QR scan
ev_marker_assigned: {filename} marked as the QR frame by hand
ev_consent_change_one: {name} changed the decision: the only photo allowed
ev_photos_grouped_from_qr_one: 1 photo grouped from the QR scan
pdf_identity: This record describes a submission; it does not verify identity.
r_name_missing: Not supplied (a name is not requested for denial or withdrawal)
r_accounts: Where to find the photographer's work
h_eyebrow: A CHANCE ENCOUNTER. A LASTING MEMORY.
err_expired: This link or form expired. Please reload the page.
err_reload: Please reload the page and try again.
err_rate: Too many requests. Please try again shortly.
err_marker_elsewhere: This QR marker was already uploaded in another set.
err_photos_unavailable: These photos are not currently available. Reload your card.
err_nothing_to_withdraw: There is no previous decision to withdraw.
err_retry: Only failed jobs can be retried.
err_print: Final printing needs a lasting public URL. Use the local preview.
err_delivered_close: Assigned cards can only be voided or deleted.
err_marker_closed: A photographed QR card is closed and cannot receive photos.
err_marker_other_set: A photographed QR card already belongs to another set.
err_marker_code: No QR card has this code. Enter the 16-character code printed on the card.
err_marker_delivered: This photo was assigned to a QR card and cannot become a marker.
err_card_move: A card with photos cannot move to a different set.
err_link: {field}: this doesn't look like a username or web address.
err_qr_timeout: A QR marker took too long to scan. Try a tighter card photograph.
err_one_marker: Use one People in Photographs QR card per marker photo.
err_select_deliver: Select at least one photograph to assign.
err_grant: Confirm you are the adult pictured.
err_not_asked: The photographer is not asking for permission for these photos.
err_language_form: Reload the form in your chosen language.
err_grouping_mode: Choose where the QR marker appears in each photo group.
err_ready_set: Choose ready photos from this set.
err_ready_group: Choose ready photographs from this proposed group.
err_not_jpeg: This file is not a JPEG. Export it as a JPEG (.jpg) and upload it again.
err_too_large: This file is larger than 25 MB. Export a smaller JPEG and upload it again.
err_server: Something went wrong on our side ({kind}). It has been logged; please try again in a moment.
s_skipped: These files were not uploaded because they are not JPEGs: {names}. Export them as JPEG (.jpg) to include them.
err_marker_unknown: No QR card has the code in this frame.
err_cleanup: Finish every detected QR group with at least one assigned photo before cleanup.
err_duplicate: This exact file already exists in another set or a deletion record. Export a new version.
err_form_changed: The photos, wording, or decision changed. Reload and review the form before submitting.
pr_cards_intro: What is printed beside the QR code on every card you generate.
pr_logo_hint: PNG with a transparent background, or JPEG. At least 1000 pixels on the long side; landscape or square works best. Light logos vanish on the white card, so check the preview.
pr_logo_alt: Your logo as it prints on a white card
pr_card_text_placeholder: A moment, yours to keep. Your photo, in a few days.
pr_card_text_hint: Pre-fills the sentence when you generate a batch; you can still change it there. Up to {max} characters, in any language.
card_text_note: Printed beside the QR code on every card in this batch. Set a default in your profile.
err_logo_format: The logo must be a PNG or JPEG file.
err_logo_large: The logo is larger than 5 MB. Export a smaller file and upload it again.
pr_release_text: Permission text shown to the person photographed
pr_release_hint: One text, in any language. To reach people in more than one language, write each version after the other in the same box; the whole text is shown and recorded.
